text: I'm so sorry to be bothering you at this hour. I'm minding my grandson, he is 3, and I took his temperature and it was 39.2. He has a few insect bites on his legs from the garden that he keeps scratching at, they're itchy little bumps. His mum and dad are out and I didn't want to ring them for nothing. I just wanted someone to tell me if I'm doing the right thing. Thank you and sorry again
